score.reasoning: Structured logging absent (0/2), correlation IDs absent (0/2), metrics collection absent (0/2), request tracing blocked (0/2), log levels partial (0.8/2). Bare console.error() in 36+ production routes with no context propagation.

checks.name: Structured Logging
checks.description: No logging library (winston, pino, logrus) installed. 36+ console.error() calls across /api/ routes log only error message, no context.
evidence: package.json: no pino, winston, bunyan dependencies
checks.impact: Operators cannot diagnose errors: no request ID, user ID, tenant ID, Supabase response details, timing. Silent catch blocks hide failures.
checks.recommendation: Install pino, create api/_lib/logger.js, replace console calls with structured logs including requestId, method, path, status, userId, tenantId.

checks.name: Correlation IDs
checks.description: No request ID generation, no header propagation, no correlation ID in logs. API routes do not read x-vercel-request-id or x-request-id headers.
evidence: api/dashboard/chat-bridge.js:239-260: bridge fetch() missing correlation ID header
No middleware to accept or generate correlation IDs
checks.impact: Cannot trace a request from frontend → API → Supabase → bridge. Each service boundary is invisible. MTTR unacceptably high.
checks.recommendation: Add correlation ID middleware or per-route: read x-request-id header or generate UUID. Propagate to Supabase, bridge, and Anthropic API calls via headers.

checks.name: Metrics Collection
checks.description: No Prometheus client, StatsD, CloudWatch, or custom metrics instrumentation. No latency histograms, error counters, or health gauges.
evidence: package.json: no prom-client or metrics library
checks.impact: No visibility into request latency, error rates, Supabase query duration, bridge connectivity health. Cannot set SLA alerts or detect degradation.
checks.recommendation: Install prom-client. Add histograms for critical routes (haiku-chat, chat-bridge, supabase calls). Add counters for errors per table/operation. Configure Vercel to scrape.

checks.name: Request Tracing
checks.description: No end-to-end request traces. No OpenTelemetry, Jaeger, or correlation ID propagation. Each service boundary is opaque.
evidence: No trace context passed to bridge, Supabase, or Anthropic calls
checks.impact: Operator cannot reconstruct request flow across service boundaries. Diagnosis requires manually checking three independent log sources.
checks.recommendation: Implement correlation IDs (check #2) first. Then add lightweight trace context: log operation type and duration at each boundary (Supabase query, bridge request, Anthropic call).

checks.name: Log Levels
checks.description: Mixed use of console.log/error. No consistent log level discipline. Non-fatal errors logged at ERROR level. Silent success paths.
evidence: api/dashboard/v2-task-update.js:72 console.log() for info (should be info level)
api/dashboard/v2-task-update.js:75 console.error() for non-fatal (should be warn level)
No info logs for successful operations
checks.impact: Operators cannot filter alerts by severity. Non-fatal failures trigger ERRORs, muddying SLA monitoring. Success paths invisible.
checks.recommendation: Use logger.info() for happy paths and normal operations. Use logger.warn() for non-fatal failures. Use logger.error() only for critical failures.

recommended_actions.title: Add Structured Logger
recommended_actions.description: Install pino, create api/_lib/logger.js, replace 40+ console calls with structured logs including requestId, method, path, status, userId, tenantId.
recommended_actions.impact: CRITICAL — enables context propagation and filters

recommended_actions.title: Add Correlation ID Generation + Propagation
recommended_actions.description: Generate UUID or read x-request-id header. Propagate via headers to Supabase, bridge, Anthropic calls. Log in every structured log entry.

recommended_actions.title: Add Latency Logging
recommended_actions.description: Time Supabase PATCH, bridge POST, Anthropic API calls. Log duration in milliseconds with operation type and status.

recommended_actions.title: Add Error Context Fields
recommended_actions.description: Log HTTP method/path/statusCode, Supabase table/operation/status, user/tenant ID, error stack trace.

recommended_actions.title: Metrics for Critical Paths
recommended_actions.description: Add histograms for haiku_api_response_time_ms, bridge_request_duration_ms. Add counters for supabase_errors, bridge_timeouts. Configure Vercel scrape.
recommended_actions.impact: MEDIUM — enables SLA monitoring and alerting

gaps_not_audited: Frontend error boundaries (React component errors silently fail)
Error reporting service integration (Sentry, Rollbar absent)
Health check endpoints (exist but don't report bridge/Anthropic API health)
Unhandled promise rejections (.catch(() => {}) silently swallows errors)
conclusion: Corner is NOT diagnosable in production. Operators cannot trace user-reported failures across service boundaries. Lack of correlation IDs and structured logging makes MTTR unacceptably high. Implement Tier 1 (structured logger + correlation IDs) immediately.
implementation_order: Add structured logger + correlation ID generation + propagation (Tier 1, 8h total)
Add latency + error context logging (Tier 2, 4h total)
